customManagers.description: Renovate's npm manager skips the govue pnpm git dependency (skipReason unversioned-reference) because of its '&path:/web' suffix. This manager reads the tag out of web/package.json so the npm half is updated like any other dependency.

The Dockerfile's Node stage installs pnpm through corepack at the version of its PNPM_VERSION argument, which Renovate's Dockerfile manager does not read. This manager reads the argument under its renovate comment, so it moves with the mise.toml pin.

packageRules.description: A govue release is one tag with a Go module and an npm package. Both halves move in one pull request, because task check:govue-version refuses a repository that pins them to different tags. Renovate regenerates no lock file for the custom manager, so the govue-lockfile preset of the shared workflows repository runs one fixed post upgrade command for web/pnpm-lock.yaml. The pnpm constraint equals the pin in mise.toml: move both together.

pnpm is pinned in mise.toml (mise manager), in the Dockerfile's PNPM_VERSION (the regex manager above) and in the govue rule's constraints.pnpm, which Renovate reads itself as a tool constraint (renovate-config manager). All three move in one pull request: internal/depsync's TestRenovateGroupsGovueHalves and TestDockerfilePnpmMatchesMise fail when one differs from mise.toml, because the image must read the lockfile with the pnpm that wrote it.
